content.text: Use high-temperature grease to lubricate the bearings and gears when assembling the starter.
Apply grease to the armature bearings and insert the armature into the field frame.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of brush holder and brushes into starter assembly, with hands holding screwdriver to compress brush spring

items: (a) Using a screwdriver, hold the brush spring back and install the brush into the brush holder. Install four brushes.

content.text: Make sure that the positive lead wires are not grounded.

items: (b) Place the O-ring on the field frame.
(c) Install the end cover to the field frame.

content.text: 3. INSTALL FIELD FRAME WITH ARMATURE IN MAGNETIC SWITCH

items: (a) Place the O-ring on the field frame.
(b) Match the protrusion of the field frame with the magnetic switch.

content.description: Exploded view showing field frame assembly and magnetic switch being aligned and assembled

content.text: 4. INSERT STEEL BALL AND SPRING INTO CLUTCH SHAFT HOLE
Apply grease to the ball and insert it into the clutch shaft hole.

content.description: Hands inserting steel ball and spring into clutch shaft hole

items: (a) Apply grease to the gear and clutch assembly.
(b) Place the clutch assembly and idler gear in the starter housing.
(c) Install the pinion gear onto the armature shaft.

content.description: Exploded view showing idler gear, bearing, and clutch assembly components and their assembly orientation
